<?php
class Store {
    private $records, $listeners = [], $serial = 0, $revision = 0;
    function __construct($records) { $this->records = $records; }
    function read($id) { return $this->records[$id] ?? ''; }
    function subscribe($fn) { $token = ++$this->serial; $this->listeners[$token] = $fn; return $token; }
    function stop($token) { unset($this->listeners[$token]); }
    function write($id, $text) {
        $this->records[$id] = $text;
        $event = ['id'=>$id, 'text'=>$text, 'revision'=>++$this->revision];
        foreach ($this->listeners as $token=>$fn) if (isset($this->listeners[$token])) $fn($event);
        return $event;
    }
}
class Trailing {
    private $env, $delay, $work, $handle = null, $pending = null;
    function __construct($env, $delay, $work) { $this->env=$env; $this->delay=$delay; $this->work=$work; }
    function push($value) {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $this->pending=$value;
        $this->handle=$this->env->schedule(function() { $this->flush(); }, $this->delay);
    }
    function flush() {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $value=$this->pending; $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;
        if ($value !== null) ($this->work)($value);
    }
    function cancel() {
        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);
        $this->pending=null; $this->handle=null;
    }
}

class Badge {public $id,$buffer;private $env,$token;function __construct($env,$id,$buffer){$this->env=$env;$this->id=$id;$this->buffer=$buffer;$this->token=$env->store->subscribe(function($e)use($env,$id){if($e['id']===$id)$env->output('status',$e);});}function detach(){$this->env->store->stop($this->token);}}
class BufferBank {public $entries=[];function get($env,$id){if(!isset($this->entries[$id]))$this->entries[$id]=new Trailing($env,120,function($text)use($env,$id){$env->write($id,$text);});return $this->entries[$id];}}
class Workspace {private $env,$current=null,$generation=0;private $bank;function __construct($env){$this->env=$env;$this->bank=new BufferBank();}
 private function retire(){$old=$this->current;$this->current=null;if($old)$old->detach();$this->env->output('document',null);if($old)$old->buffer->flush();}
 function open($id){$request=++$this->generation;$this->retire();if($request!==$this->generation)return;$buffer=$this->bank->get($this->env,$id);$this->current=new Badge($this->env,$id,$buffer);$this->env->output('document',['id'=>$id,'text'=>$this->env->store->read($id)]);}
 function edit($text){$view=$this->current;if($view){$view->buffer->push($text);}}function close(){++$this->generation;$this->retire();}function dispose(){$this->close();}
}
class Preview {private $task;function __construct($env){$this->task=new Trailing($env,40,function($q)use($env){$env->output('preview',['query'=>$q]);});}function query($text){$this->task->push($text);}function hide(){$this->task->cancel();}}

Verify a new burst after an earlier flush schedules and saves independently.

forbidden_effects: Do not continue writing to the Store on every edit.
Do not save an older value from a burst after a newer value has been accepted.
Do not associate a pending edit with whichever document happens to be current when the timer fires.
Do not cancel or discard an accepted document edit merely because its Badge subscription is detached.
Do not let an outer navigation operation overwrite navigation synchronously initiated by a save callback.
Do not merge document-buffer ownership into Badge lifecycle ownership.
Do not change Store identity, text, revision, subscription, or status-payload semantics.
Do not change Preview timing, cancellation behavior, interface, or responsibility.
Do not change public workspace interfaces or edit tests/configuration.
lifecycle_identity: A document buffer is identified by document ID and is owned by the separate BufferBank service.
A Badge represents the current view and owns only its live Store subscription; retiring a Badge must not destroy its document buffer.
Each accepted edit belongs to the buffer captured from the current Badge at acceptance time.
Workspace generation identifies whether an open request still has authority after retirement and any callback-capable save.
A Trailing instance must retire its consumed pending value and timer handle before invoking its work callback so a later or reentrant burst has independent state.

obligations.text: Workspace::edit must, when a current Badge exists, push the supplied text to that Badge's per-document Trailing buffer instead of writing to the Store immediately; with no current Badge it remains a no-op.
Each document buffer must use the existing Trailing utility with a 120 ms delay and write to the document ID captured when that buffer was created.
Every edit in an active burst must replace the pending value and reset the timer, so only the latest text is written after 120 ms without another edit.
After a flush, the buffer must remain reusable so subsequent bursts for the same document continue to save.

Pending accepted edits must remain associated with their original document across switching, same-document reopening, close, and dispose. Departure handling must preserve the prior immediate-persistence observable behavior sufficiently that destination reads are not stale and accepted edits are not lost.

Before callback-capable saving, consumed pending state must be cleared as Trailing::flush currently does, preventing duplicate consumption and allowing edits triggered during saving to form a subsequent burst.

Retirement must revoke the departing Badge's current ownership and detach its captured subscription while retaining the BufferBank entry. Any pending departure save must not allow an outer stale open or close to overwrite synchronous nested navigation.
Preserve Store read/write/subscribe behavior, status filtering by document ID, document output semantics, public Workspace methods, and BufferBank reuse.
Leave Preview unchanged, including its 40 ms trailing task and hide cancellation.

ordering_barriers: Capture the current Badge and its buffer when accepting an edit; do not resolve the destination document later at timer execution.
On a replacement edit, cancel the prior timer before installing the new pending value and timer.
In Trailing::flush, cancel the handle, snapshot the pending value, and clear pending/handle state before invoking the save callback.

When leaving a document, revoke current-view authority and complete subscription cleanup/clearing in an order that prevents the departing Badge from receiving saved status as current while still preserving the accepted edit.

Because Store listeners may navigate synchronously, revalidate the Workspace generation after any retirement path that can flush a pending buffer and before installing an opened destination or applying another outer visible effect.
preservation: Keep createWorkspace behavior exposed as open(id), edit(text), close(), and dispose().
Keep document buffers separate from Badge subscriptions and reuse one buffer per document ID.
Keep Store writes synchronous, including record replacement before listener notification and monotonically increasing revision events.
Keep status events filtered to the Badge's document ID.
Keep document rendering based on Store.read(id), including the existing empty-string default for absent records.
Keep close and dispose retirement behavior, including clearing document output and detaching the live subscription.
Keep Preview's independent 40 ms quiet interval and hide cancellation.
Keep source identities, text, and status payloads unchanged.
scope: Business behavior in src/workflow.php for Workspace edit autosave, per-document BufferBank usage, Trailing coordination, and the minimum retirement/navigation safeguards required to preserve existing editor behavior.
Read-only consideration of Store, Badge, and Preview behavior insofar as it defines preservation boundaries.
No changes to tests, configuration, dependencies, public evaluator material, or the adjacent Preview feature.
